text:
Alex: Quick check — vendor sent an updated slot manifest. Can someone confirm if apac-a100 pool can lend 4 GPUs overnight (Thu->Fri) for the Q3 demo? PR #4532 is blocked on capacity.
Kevin: I glanced at the manifest, shows 8 standby in apac region but 2 are flagged for firmware update. Not sure about lending windows. @vendor-ops any ETA? :eyes:
vendor-ops: We can hold 4 GPUs as a soft-standby, but need a formal carve for 18:00-03:00 UTC. Firmware patch window is Fri 06:00 UTC — so carve OK if you return before 05:30. Note: running a soft-reserve incurs a short invoice hold.
Maria: If we take those 4, can we keep instance images the same? We don't have time to bake new AMIs before demo.
Jess: Agree with Maria — avoid h100 swap, stick to a100 to reduce bake. I'll mark PR #4532 with "use-a100-standby" tag.
Alex: Thanks. Two quick follow-ups: 1) can vendor-ops add a tenant tag so billing maps to demo account? 2) Kevin, can you drop a terraform snippet into the PR for the reservation?
Kevin: Pasting quick snippet (will tidy in PR): `resource "google_compute_reservation" "demo-night" { name = "rdw-demo-overnight" zone = "asia-southeast1-a" cpu_platform = "" specific_reservation_parameters { type = "GPU" gpus = 4 gpu_type = "a100" } }`
vendor-ops: Tenant tag ✅ — we'll set label `demo_team=ux-demo`. Billing note: there will be a hold flag but we can waive it for this carve if finance okays; pinged @oncall-bot to create invoice note.
oncall-bot: Finance notified: ticket FIN-1987 created (auto). Please include final return timestamp in the PR.
Maria: I'll coordinate the AMI check — if tests pass on one node by 16:30 UTC we can proceed.
Jess: I'm taking the PR ownership, will add the reservation tf, label, and update PR description with return ETA format. @Alex can you confirm the exact demo window?
Alex: Demo window is 19:00-22:00 UTC, but ops asked for extended carve to cover warmup, so target reserve 18:00-03:00 UTC and return by 05:15 UTC at the latest. If vendor-ops waives the invoice hold that's ideal.
Kevin: Noted. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to add the `labels = { demo_team = "ux-demo" }` and add the return timestamp placeholder.
vendor-ops: All set on our side. We'll publish the soft-standby at 18:00 UTC and tag the GPUs; please confirm via this thread once reservation tf is merged so we can flip the carve to hard-reserve.
Alex: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jess: Quick reminder — if anything falls through, fallback plan is a short borrow from eu-west (latency ok for demo). I'll keep that on deck.
Kevin: Cool. I'll merge the tf PR once tests pass. Last message before lunch — will update here.
Alex: Great. Closing loop: PR #4532 owners (Jess/Kevin), vendor-ops holds 4 a100s, finance ticket FIN-1987, return timestamp placeholder in PR, follow-up if carve needs to become hard-reserve.
